title: refactor: simplify Polli internals and integrations
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Centralizes GitHub App, PAT, and project-PAT selection while preserving App-first behavior and project diagnostics.
- Normalizes webhook mention actors and routes five single-URL scrape actions through one dispatcher without changing options, errors, or fallbacks.
- Removes unused AI-client formatters plus legacy prompt, attachment, and data-visualization aliases; the active `render_visual` path is unchanged.
- Extracts Discord thread media once and passes separated image, video, and file lists into the existing processing path.
- Removes 172 net lines across 12 Polli files.

Validation:
- Merged current `main` without conflicts; no newer main commit touched `apps/polli`.
- Polli unittest discovery: 7 passed.
- Ruff lint, Python compile, diff checks, and removed-symbol repository scans passed.
- Side-by-side behavior matrices passed for GitHub auth selection (5 configurations), scraper dispatch (21 scenarios), and webhook contexts/prompts (5 event families).
- Previous head passed both CI / Pull request checks and CI / CodeQL; fresh exact-head checks are required before merge.

gist.headline: Polli sheds some exoskeleton
gist.blurb: Polli's wiring got a careful tidy: fewer old aliases, one path for scrapes, and GitHub credentials chosen in one place. Same helpful bot, less attic.
gist.summary: Refactored the Polli app by centralizing GitHub App/PAT/project-PAT selection, routing five single-URL scraper actions through one dispatcher, and removing 172 net lines of unused AI and integration code while preserving existing behavior.
gist.impact: Polli keeps its App-first GitHub authentication, scraper options and fallbacks, and Discord media-processing behavior, with simpler internals for future changes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful maintainer in a cozy garden-shed workshop, sorting several GitHub credential keys into one labeled toolbox while a single irrigation pipe feeds five small URL-shaped code-plants. A retro terminal and neatly bundled Discord image, video, and file sprites suggest consolidated integrations; the scene should communicate cleanup without implying a user-visible feature change.
